description:
## Why This Exists

post/ipfs_write.rs::IpfsBlockStore trait has a default delete() impl that returns DeletionOutcome::Deferred. MemIpfsStore does not override it, so deletes on the in-memory store are no-ops. KuboBlockStore overrides delete() with pin_rm(). This means tests that use MemIpfsStore cannot test the delete path.

The default impl makes sense as a 'not yet implemented' stub but the doc comment says 'Override to provide backend-specific behaviour' without explaining that the default is a no-op. An implementor who forgets to override gets silent data retention.

## Acceptance Criteria

Change the default to either panic! (forcing implementors to be explicit) or document explicitly that the default is 'block retained until GC' and add #[allow(unused)] to silence warnings on _cid in default.
title: Rust idiom: IpfsBlockStore::delete default impl never called — API misleads implementors
